purpose: Read-only OBJ topology evidence; no mesh data was modified or written. Spatial labels are candidates, not semantic/art approval.
coordinate_evidence: Despite the supplied +Z-up inspection convention, raw OBJ extents show the modeled figure is +Y-up: a single flat plane spans X/Z at Y≈0.00488281 and the figure extent is Y=0..0.70654297. This report therefore uses Y for source-space height.

weld_test.method: all position pairs max-axis-distance <= 1e-6 raw units unioned before face connectivity

decision_aids.safe_only_if_visually_confirmed: A deletion candidate must be a separate component and must not affect silhouette in existing inspection cameras. Welding only joins vertices at <=1e-6; it does not close boundary loops or fix nonmanifold topology.
decision_aids.head_cleanup_risk: All 12 small upper-region components have open boundaries and overlap the head zone. They may be intended layered hair/face geometry; there is no topology-only evidence that any is a flyaway. Do not bulk-delete them. The largest thin pieces (17, 37, 30) are especially silhouette-risky because their Y ranges extend 0.125–0.215 of figure height.
decision_aids.recommended_next_observation: Keep only component 32 eligible for automatic deletion. In a temporary flat-color copy, isolate each upper-region ID against components 5 and 6 in existing front/back/side inspection cameras; select a non-floor deletion only after it is visibly outside the desired silhouette in all relevant views.
